waitingTriage.title: Thank you for trusting us
waitingTriage.subtitle: Your file has arrived, and a professional is reading it carefully now.
waitingTriage.reviewing: A professional is reviewing your file
waitingTriage.expected: Expected within about {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}
waitingTriage.expectedSoon: We are reviewing your file. Thank you for your patience
waitingTriage.reviewed: A professional has reviewed your file
waitingTriage.addSub: Forgot to mention something in the summary?
waitingTriage.addendumLabel: What would you like to add?
waitingTriage.addendumHint: It will reach the professional together with your summary.
waitingTriage.addendumSent: We added it to your summary. Thank you.
waitingTriage.helpHint: If you feel worse before the review, press <help>Help now</help> and our team will contact you directly.

breathing.label: Three-minute breathing exercise
breathing.intro: Breathe in for 4 seconds, hold for 4 seconds, then breathe out for 6 seconds.
breathing.done: Well done. Take a moment to notice how you feel now.

closed.title: Thank you for sharing with us
closed.body: A professional has read your file carefully. We think another service can help you better right now, so we will not suggest therapists here. This is not a rejection of you, and what you are going through deserves care.
closed.referralsTitle: Where we suggest you reach out

emergency_services.title: Emergency services
emergency_services.body: If you are in danger now or thinking about harming yourself, call emergency services right away.

crisis_line.title: Mental health support line
crisis_line.body: Trained people who will listen and guide you, at any time.

psychiatry.title: A psychiatrist
psychiatry.body: For a deeper assessment, which may include medication. Ask your doctor or the nearest hospital for a referral.

primary_care.title: Your primary care doctor
primary_care.body: Visit your nearest primary health care centre, and take what you wrote in your summary with you if you like.

community_support.title: Community support
community_support.body: Groups and support programmes in your area that can be with you meanwhile.

closed.stillHere: Your account, safety plan and exercises stay available to you. If you feel worse, press Help now at any time.

escalated.title: We want to check on you now
escalated.body: A professional has read your file and thinks it is best for our immediate support team to contact you directly. Open the help screen to see the emergency numbers and how we are reaching you.
escalated.hint: If you are in danger now, do not wait: call emergency services.
